questions.prompt: Which phylum has animals with jointed legs and an exoskeleton?
An earthworm belongs to which phylum?
questions.explain: Its body is divided into ring-like segments.

questions.prompt: Why is a bat classified as a mammal, not a bird?
options: It has fur and feeds its young on milk
questions.explain: Flying doesn’t decide the class; fur and milk do.

questions.prompt: Match each animal to its group.
questions.explain: Spiny skin, soft body with foot, stinging tentacles, flat body.
Their body temperature follows the surroundings.

questions.prompt: A frog has smooth, moist skin, lays eggs in water, and its young breathe with gills. Which class is it?
questions.explain: Amphibians live a “double life” in water and on land.

questions.prompt: A student says a whale is a fish because it lives in the sea and has fins. Use three features to explain why it is a mammal.
questions.modelAnswer: Whales breathe air using lungs, not gills; they are warm-blooded; they give birth to live young and feed them on milk; they have some hair. These are mammal features. Living in water and having fins are adaptations to their habitat, not features used for classification.
rubric: Habitat and fins are adaptations, not the basis of classification
